speaker: charlie
text: Right, Origin news dropped yesterday and there are some massive calls. <cite index='25-2,25-3'>Queensland's 20-man squad is in camp in Brisbane right now, preparing for Game One at Accor Stadium next week on May 27th.</cite> Four blokes are getting their debut Maroons jerseys.

speaker: alice
text: <cite index='25-3'>Jojo Fifita from the Titans, Sam Walker from the Roosters, Max Plath from the Dolphins, and Briton Nikora from Cronulla are all getting their first taste of Origin.</cite> That's some serious fresh blood in the squad.

speaker: charlie
text: <cite index='28-1'>Big changes too - Kalyn Ponga's getting the fullback spot instead of Reece Walsh, and rookie Sam Walker's stepping in at halfback with Tom Dearden injured.</cite> <cite index='26-20,26-21'>Queensland's defending champions after winning 2025, and they lead the all-time count 25 to 17.</cite> Should be a cracker.
